headline: Approved a Sunday entertainment permit for a back-to-school event at Riverfront Park.
summary: Luisa Fernandez of Ready Set School applied for the permit. The event runs from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM for about 100 people, with a Fitchburg Police detail. Fernandez confirmed she knows all entertainment must shut down thirty minutes before closing.
decisions: Approved the Sunday entertainment permit for Ready Set School's August 9, 2026 event, 2-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Luisa Fernandez, Ready Set School, Riverfront Park, 35 Cushing Street, Sunday, August 9, 2026, from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM for approximately 100 people. ... Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 2/0.

MINUTES OF SPECIAL MEETING 
A special meeting of the Board of L icense Commissioners was held on Friday, August 7, 2026 VIA zoom 
and called to order by Commissioner Sarefield at 3:00 PM. Commissioner Boscardin  and Commissioner 
Fossa were present.  City Clerk Joanna Bilotta and Assistant City Clerk Elizabeth McNiff were present.  
 
I. NEW APPLICATIONS 
Please note that the Commission may enter into Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, sec. 21(a) 
(5) (Discussion of CORI results), if required during this portion of the agenda, and will return to 
regular session upon completion. 
 
Sunday Entertainment Permit  
Luisa Fernandez, Ready Set School, Riverfront Park, 35 Cushing Street, Sunday, August 9, 2026, from 
12:00 PM to 3:30 PM for approximately 100 people. 
Ms. Fernandez was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and 
verified that Ms. Fernandez is aware that all entertainment must be shut down thirty minutes prior to 
closing. Ms. Fernandez informed the commission that this is a back-to-school event, and that this event 
will have Fitchburg Police detail.  
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 2/0.  
NEXT REGULAR MEETING 
 
Thursday, September 3, 2026 
 
The meeting adjourned at 3:12 PM 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Joanna Bilotta, City Clerk
